Plot publication-quality haplotype figures for a list of genes

Source: R/plot-functions.r
hbr_plot_gene_list.Rd

Builds a four-panel figure per gene (gene model, haplotype network, haplotype summary table, trait distribution) and saves each figure in the requested formats. `gene_list` may be a character vector of gene IDs, a path to a summary CSV, a directory containing the pipeline outputs, or an in-memory `data.table`.

Usage

hbr_plot_gene_list(
  gene_list,
  output_dir = NULL,
  summary_csv = NULL,
  per_gene_dir = NULL,
  result = NULL,
  reference = NULL,
  gff3_path = NULL,
  trait_col = "NT",
  trait_label = NULL,
  n_gene = NULL,
  sort_by = c("Cohens_d", "Superior_Mean"),
  panels = c("gene_model", "haplotype_network", "haplotype_table", "trait_boxplot"),
  palette = "haplobreed",
  theme = "haplobreed",
  table_style = c("color_coded", "row_highlight"),
  include_nt = FALSE,
  include_aa = FALSE,
  aa_full_names = TRUE,
  width = 12,
  height = 14,
  formats = c("pdf", "png"),
  combined_pdf = TRUE,
  figures_dir = "figures",
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

gene_list

IDs, CSV path, directory path, or data.frame.

output_dir

Directory holding per-gene files.

summary_csv

Optional path to the summary CSV.

per_gene_dir

Override for the directory holding per-gene files.

result

Optional in-memory [haplobreed_analysis()] output.

reference

Optional `hbr_reference` object.

gff3_path

Optional GFF3 path; parsed once and cached for the session.

trait_col

Trait column name.

trait_label

Human-readable trait label.

n_gene

Keep at most this many genes.

sort_by

Character vector of columns to rank by.

panels

Panels to draw.

palette

One of [hbr_palette_names()].

theme

One of [hbr_theme_names()].

table_style

`"color_coded"` or `"row_highlight"`.

include_nt, include_aa

Include NT / AA sequence columns.

aa_full_names

Use three-letter amino-acid codes.

width, height

Figure dimensions in inches.

formats

Output formats.

combined_pdf

Also write a multi-page PDF.

figures_dir

Subdirectory of `output_dir` for figures.

verbose

Print progress.

Value

Invisibly, a list with `plots`, `files`, `missing_genes`, `combined_pdf`.
